FIELDS.NAME: Gourmet Gatherings Catering
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Sarah Johnson, Food Safety Compliance Officer, 555-123-4567, sjohnson@gourmetgatherings.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Gatherings Catering specializes in providing high-quality catering and food preparation services for a variety of events, including weddings, corporate meetings, and private gatherings. We pride ourselves on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients to create customizable menus that cater to diverse dietary needs, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Our professional team is well-trained in food handling procedures to ensure the highest standards of hygiene and minimize the risk of any issues. All staff members complete certified food handler training, and we maintain thorough documentation of ingredient sourcing and supplier certifications for transparency. Our operations are backed by commercial-grade equipment for proper food storage and transportation, including temperature-controlled vehicles for perishable items. We regularly conduct internal audits of our practices and have a comprehensive plan in place for responding to any incidents, ensuring we address any concerns swiftly and effectively. By maintaining clear communication with our clients and prioritizing their satisfaction, we aim to create memorable culinary experiences at every event we serve.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 28, 2023, during a corporate event, a minor incident resulted in a spill leading to the damaged flooring at the venue, costing $2,000 for repairs. The situation was promptly resolved, and there were no injuries or further claims related to this incident. The claim is currently closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe for cash and important documents, Class B, Fire-rated, UL labeled.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the premises and on-site security personnel during high-profile events.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of their operations. Their focus is on high-quality catering services using fresh, locally sourced ingredients.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of their business operations. Their focus is primarily on providing catering services for events such as weddings, corporate meetings, and private gatherings.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our Food Safety Compliance Officer to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. They maintain a commitment to ethical and lawful business practices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering has not had any policies declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. They have maintained a positive insurance history with their previous carrier.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff members are directly employed by the business.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Gourmet Gatherings Catering carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect their employees. This policy is active and maintained to cover any potential workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Gourmet Gatherings Catering also operates a related business, Gourmet Gatherings Event Planning Services, which complements their catering offerings.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. They currently hold one active policy, which covers their catering operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Their operations focus solely on providing catering and food preparation services for various events.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering does not rent or loan equipment to others. Their focus is solely on providing catering and food preparation services for events.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as their operations focus on safe food preparation and catering using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. All food safety protocols are adhered to, ensuring minimal risk.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering does not have any catastrophe exposure as their operations are focused on providing food catering services in controlled environments with established safety protocols. They prioritize thorough planning and risk management to mitigate potential issues.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains strong hiring practices and a commitment to ethical standards.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Gourmet Gatherings Catering has no uncorrected fire code violations and is committed to maintaining compliance with all relevant fire safety regulations.
